title: CI hardening: block hidden/bidirectional Unicode controls repo-wide
description: Add scripts/check-hidden-unicode.mjs to scan tracked text files for dangerous invisible/bidi control characters (bidi embed/override/isolate, zero-width chars, directional marks, ALM, BOM, soft hyphen, CGJ). Wire check:hidden-unicode into the root check script so CI blocks them, while allowing benign visible Unicode punctuation (em/en dash, arrows, curly quotes, degree). Set Biome suspicious.noIrregularWhitespace to error as supplemental protection. Add a unit test and docs.
close_reason: Implemented scripts/check-hidden-unicode.mjs, wired into check, Biome noIrregularWhitespace=error, tests + docs. PR #155 to main.
